# Sonexial

> Sonexial builds done-for-you author websites structured for AI-era discovery. DIY builders give you templates. Traditional designers give you a polished site. Sonexial gives you an author platform built with semantic structure, schema, entity clarity, and GEO from day one.

Sonexial provides author website development, Generative Engine Optimization, author platform strategy, book landing pages, email capture setup, book description writing, and AI visibility monitoring.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://sonexial.com/) - Overview of Sonexial services, process, FAQ, and contact information.
- [Examples](https://sonexial.com/examples) - Example author website directions for romance, fantasy, and contemporary fiction.
- [Kits](https://sonexial.com/kits) - Author marketing and optimization kits.
- [Ad Copy Suite](https://sonexial.com/ad-copy-suite) - Amazon Sponsored Products and Facebook/Meta ad copy package for indie authors.
- [Metadata & Amazon Optimization Kit](https://sonexial.com/metadata-kit) - Metadata optimization service including description, subtitle, keywords, and author bio.
- [BISAC & Category Strategy Kit](https://sonexial.com/bisac-kit) - BISAC code and Amazon browse category strategy for better discoverability.
- [Author Website SEO & AI Visibility Audit](https://sonexial.com/website-seo-audit) - Audit for author websites covering on-page SEO, keyword gaps, page structure, and AI visibility.
- [Author Website GEO & AI Visibility Audit](https://sonexial.com/tools/author-geo-audit/) - Free live GEO scanner auditing schema markup, llms.txt, robots.txt crawler rules, and AI discovery readiness.
- [Cover Design Signal Audit](https://sonexial.com/cover-design-audit) - Cover review focused on genre fit, thumbnail legibility, and competitive positioning.
- [Amazon Book Ad Profit Calculator](https://sonexial.com/calculator) - Free calculator for estimating ad profitability after royalties and ad costs.
- [About](https://sonexial.com/about) - Background on Sonexial and founder information.
- [Privacy](https://sonexial.com/privacy) - Privacy Policy.
- [Terms](https://sonexial.com/terms) - Terms of Service.
- [Refund Policy](https://sonexial.com/refund-policy) - Refund and cancellation terms.

## Services

- One-time infrastructure kits for metadata, ad copy, BISAC/category strategy, cover analysis, and SEO/AI visibility.
- Ongoing support subscriptions for Amazon ranking changes, metadata maintenance, and title audits.
- A done-for-you description overhaul for authors needing a deeper rewrite.

## Founder

Sonexial was founded by Brian Plescher, an author and strategist based in Grand Haven, Michigan.
